description: Na₃ErTi₂Nb₂O₁₂ is Orthorhombic Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.91 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.81 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.68 Å. Er is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Er-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.55 Å. There are two inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-33°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.87-2.15 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-32°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.13 Å. There are two inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-32°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.15 Å. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-33°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-2.15 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Er, one Ti, and one Nb atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ti, and one Nb atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Er, one Ti, and one Nb atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Er, one Ti, and one Nb atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Er, one Ti, and one Nb atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Er, one Ti, and one Nb atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Er, one Ti, and one Nb atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ti, and one Nb atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ti, and one Nb atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ti, and one Nb atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Er, one Ti, and one Nb atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to one Na, one Er, one Ti, and one Nb atom.
